sentence: This project studies how nearby devices can form teams and share their computing power to solve complex problems without relying on the cloud.
This project builds a method that lets large teams of mobile robots keep reliable communication while working in complex environments.
This project develops a way to learn an algorithm from training data with inputs of different sizes, so it works on inputs of any size.
This project studies how straining thin films of exotic magnets changes their magnetic properties and whether spin flips can carry information.
This project studies which proteins in the hair-like cilium of brain progenitor cells help them signal to each other during brain development.
This project builds models to predict and control how a coiled string actuator moves and senses its own strain.
This project studies how metal powder moves and is ejected as spatter when a pulsed laser melts it, and builds a model of this.
This project uses computer models to study how clusters of tumor cells move through the bloodstream and respond to the immune system.
This project builds tools that make checkpointing of scientific applications and large artificial intelligence models faster and easier to reuse.
This project develops methods for solving optimization problems with constraints on a quantum computer that works together with a classical computer.
This project studies how quantum gravity can be tested with atomic clocks and how materials change when exposed to pulsed or oscillating fields.
This project builds algorithms that find rare and unpredictable patterns in particle detector data in real time.
This project builds a robotic laboratory that people can use through the cloud to make and measure stacks of 2D materials.
This project studies how heavy elements were created and what the super-dense matter at the center of a neutron star is like.
This project develops statistical tools that find causal effects of treatments using large-scale medical imaging data.
This project builds portable sensors and a decision support system to quickly detect Salmonella in the poultry supply chain.
This project uses large language models to automatically label packet-level data collected from a research network.
This project develops artificial intelligence algorithms that run in real time on detector hardware to find physics events in a search for neutrinoless double-beta decay.
